Title: Tetrahedron Density
Description: Generate a Tetrahedron density. You can use a Scale vector to stretch and compress the Tetrahedron in different directions. You can spin it by giving it a new Y axis and a spin angle (in degrees).

Options.Label: Spin
Options.Description: Determines the angle in degrees by which to spin the Tetrahedron around its Y axis.

Outputs.Label: Curve
Outputs.Description: Maps the Tetrahedron's extent to a Density value.

Outputs.Label: Scale
Outputs.Description: Determines how much to stretch the Tetrahedron in each direction.

Outputs.Label: NewYAxis
Outputs.Description: Let you rotate the field around its origin.
